title: A documented integer magic property implemented by __get can feed an integer return

ground_truth.statement: A documented integer magic property implemented by __get can feed an integer return. This isolates the property contract without competing vendor-prefix overrides.

notes: Clean-room semantic contract derived from the catalog lead, not a copy of its test harness. Runtime controls distinguish successful values from rejected or absent alternatives. This is a behavior comparison, not a recommendation that every precision limitation is product policy. Only the documented magic property contract is retained; competing vendor-specific override precedence and write-only reads are outside this reduced criterion. All three pinned analyzers accept this reduced semantic contract; its independent runtime controls pass.
